full_judgment: 29. Provisions of rule 19 cannot be treated as a dead letter or absolute. Provisions of rule 19 are mandatory and same must be complied with due diligence, and the court after making necessary inquiry in the matter record a clear findings of due service or otherwise. In the absence of declaration made and subscribed by the process-server, as required under the rules, the service return cannot be accepted as evidence of due service, And in the absence of an inquiry made by the court as provided in rule 19 and distinct declaration of due service recorded, there is no presumption of service of summons. Presumption of service arises when record shows that process was rightly and duly served.
